info.name: DineMaster Backend - Complete API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection generated from the DineMaster Spring Boot controllers (16 controllers, all /api/v1 endpoints).

Base URL defaults to http://localhost:8081 (server.port in application.yml).

Quick start:
1. Activate a POS device (POST Auth > Activate device) or use an existing auth_devices row UUID for {{deviceId}}.
2. Run Auth > Login. The test script stores accessToken, refreshToken, tenantId, userId, deviceId and the first branchId automatically.
3. Run create requests in order; create requests save their new IDs into collection variables.

Notes:
- Login requires tenantCode (tenant name upper-cased with non-alphanumerics replaced by '-'; the V8 seed tenant 'Default Tenant' becomes DEFAULT-TENANT), a username and password. deviceId is optional; if supplied, it must be active for this tenant.
- Endpoints are guarded by @PreAuthorize permissions (menu:view, menu:manage, order:create, etc.). Use an OWNER account to exercise everything.
- Money fields are JSON numbers; dates use ISO-8601 (OffsetDateTime / LocalDate).

variable.description: Tenant code. Seed tenant 'Default Tenant' => DEFAULT-TENANT. New tenants derive code from their name.
UUID of an active auth_devices row. Generated by Activate device.
Username of an existing SUPER_ADMIN account with no tenant.

item.name: 01 - Auth & Devices
item.description: Shared authentication endpoints. Login requires tenantCode + username + password; deviceId is optional, and if supplied must be registered and active. Device provisioning: OWNER/MANAGER issues a one-time code; the device activates publicly. M1 does not define a separate Super Admin login contract.

request.description: Body matches LoginRequest: tenantCode (2-60), username (3-60), password (max 128), optional deviceId (UUID; if supplied, must be active for this tenant). Stores accessToken, refreshToken, tenantId, userId, deviceId and first branchId.
Platform login. Requires an existing active SUPER_ADMIN account with tenantId null. No tenantCode or deviceId is used.
Rotates the refresh token. Body matches RefreshRequest. Reusing a revoked token revokes the whole token family.
Returns RSA public keys for access-token verification. Public; 503 when RSA keys are not configured.
Authenticated user profile including permissions and branchIds.
Returns userId, permVersion and the resolved permission codes.
Body matches PasswordChangeRequest: currentPassword + newPassword (10-128). Revokes all refresh tokens. Also available at POST /api/v1/auth/password/change.
Revokes the supplied refresh token. Body matches RefreshRequest. Returns 204.
Revokes every active refresh token for the current user. Returns 204.
Requires device:activate (OWNER/MANAGER). Body matches ActivationCodeCreateRequest. Saves the issued activationCode (valid 15 minutes).
Public. Body matches DeviceActivationRequest: activationCode (max 100), platform (max 50), deviceName (max 100). Stores deviceId, tenantId, branchId. Rate limited per IP.
Lists active devices for the current user with label, createdAt and lastSeenAt.
Deactivates the device and revokes its refresh tokens. Returns 204.

item.name: 02 - Tenants (Super Admin)
item.description: SUPER_ADMIN platform APIs: list/create/suspend/activate tenants. Canonical path /api/v1/super-admin/tenants; each route also has the /api/v1/tenants alias. Requires ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN and the matching tenant:* permission.

request.description: Requires ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN and tenant:view.
Body matches TenantCreateRequest: name, ownerName, ownerUsername, ownerPassword (10-128). Tenant code is derived from name (SPICE-ROUTE). Saves tenantId.
Requires tenant:suspend. Deactivates the tenant, bumps permission versions, revokes tokens and devices. Returns 204.
Requires tenant:activate. Returns 204.

item.name: 03 - Roles & Permissions
item.description: Role catalogue and permission grants. /api/v1/roles. SUPER_ADMIN manages global role grants such as OWNER. Tenant OWNER manages MANAGER and tenant custom roles, and may grant only permissions the OWNER has. Changes replace the complete permission set.

request.description: Lists system + tenant roles with permissions.
All assignable permission codes sorted alphabetically.
Returns code, name and permissions for the role.
Body matches RoleCreateRequest: code ([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*, max 50), name (max 100), permissions (set of existing codes). Tenant roles may not receive tenant:/licence:/support: permissions.

Body matches RolePermissionUpdateRequest. Replaces all grants. SUPER_ADMIN can manage global roles, including OWNER. Tenant OWNER can manage MANAGER (creating a tenant override when needed) and tenant custom roles, but cannot edit OWNER or grant permissions they do not have.
Alias of the PATCH endpoint.
OWNER sees all tenant branches; other roles see only assigned branches.

Requires branch:create. Body matches the Restaurant entity: name (required, max 150), address (max 5000), phone (max 30). tenantId and createdAt are set by the server. The creator is assigned to the new branch; saves branchId/restaurantId.
Requires branch:update. Only name, address and phone are updated.
Requires branch:update. Returns 204.

item.name: 05 - Users & Staff
item.description: OWNER/MANAGER staff APIs. Canonical path /api/v1/users (also /api/v1/admin/staff); tenant and branch scope is enforced. Requires the matching user:* / role:assign permissions. SUPER_ADMIN has no default tenant staff access.

request.description: Paginated search. page>=0, 1<=size<=100, sort=field,asc|desc. Managers only see staff in their own branches.

Body matches UserRequest. name, username, password (min 10) and exactly one role are required. branchIds defaults to the actor's branches. Saves userId. Create a branch first and use its branchId from this same tenant; an unknown or cross-tenant branch returns 404.
Returns UserResponse including permissions and branchIds.
Profile-only StaffUpdateRequest. Editable fields are fullName, email, phone, employeeCode, joinedOn and shiftTiming. Role, branches, status and password use their dedicated endpoints.
Soft delete: sets active=false, bumps permission version and revokes tokens. Requires user:deactivate. Returns 204.
Body matches UserLifecycleRequest: optional reason (max 500).
Body matches UserLifecycleRequest: optional reason (max 500).
Body matches UserRoleUpdateRequest. The current identity model accepts exactly one role code. Revokes the user's tokens. Returns 204.
Body matches PasswordResetRequest: temporaryPassword (10-128) + optional reason (max 500). Forces password change and revokes tokens.
Active refresh-token sessions. Requires session:revoke.
Revokes all refresh tokens for the user and bumps permission version. Returns 204.
DELETE alias for session revocation. Returns 204.
Last 100 audit entries for the user. Requires audit:view.
Body matches UserBranchUpdateRequest. Managers may assign only their own branch. Revokes tokens. Returns 204.
